decisions.reason: The Magento 2 template was publicly recommended, sits close to the agency hosting core and costs little to maintain, so management keeps it despite no visible promotion since 2018.
The responsive template complements the hosting platform at low upkeep, and its fading visibility is read as a temporary shift of attention rather than failure.
Premium support embodies the firm's announced agency-focused, round-the-clock expert service strategy and remains central to its identity.
The version management tool carries sunk in-house development costs and visible commitment through its own page, which favors continuing it.
Scalable agency hosting is the publicly presented flagship of the firm's direction, so commitment and centrality make withdrawal very unlikely.
